acceptance_scope: P58F6 A1 visual acceptance of retained browser artifacts, not strict A0 original-game parity.
visual_findings: Both faction selected-capital panels are intact without blank, corrupt, clipped, or visibly mismatched bitmap surfaces.
All five subsystem tiles are visible and consistently aligned at native and letterboxed sizes.
Ship portraits, empty shield meters, nearly full faction-color hull meters, cockpit shells, planets, star fields, and controls remain visually coherent.
All four supporting results pass with stable paired screenshots and no recorded errors; native panel and subsystem tiles have exact source-bitmap checks.
limitations: The review inspected retained evidence rather than launching another browser session.
Portrait checks are composited rather than wholly pixel-exact.
Exact bitmap checks apply only at native size; scaled viewport checks are visual.
Original-reference comparisons remain unbaselined, so this does not establish strict A0 parity or independently prove live combat behavior.
